lado_card.texto: G0 shows the agentic company and the role of the 2027 manager. The other courses in the program build on it.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/gestao-ia · Horizonte lab (fictional study company) · inema.club

inicio.lead: Putting an agent into a process designed for people in another era only delivers the mistake faster. In eight lessons, you choose the first process, map what really happens, cut what exists out of habit, decide who does each step, measure before changing anything, and version the change. It ends with the current × future canvas approved by a rubric.
inicio.capa_alt: Office desk at dusk with a notebook showing a flowchart of colored blocks; in the background, blurred, the shelves of a warehouse.

cursos.sub: Suggested order: G0 → G2 → G3 → G4 → G1 → G5. G1 (people) can run in parallel, and if you work in HR you can start with it. Courses marked "coming soon" open as they are ready.

itens.t: The agentic company and the 2027 manager
itens.l: What changed in management, what the consultancies say, Brazil, your career and your first process.
Take the process apart before automating it: eliminate, simplify, redesign, and decide who does each step.
Role, delegation, constitution, authority limit, progressive trust, agent team, and exception queue.
Choose a model for each case, take care of context and company knowledge, and measure cost per result.
What stays with people, the conversation about change, the junior who supervises agents, and team training.

itens.rot: G5 · wrap-up + final project · coming soon
itens.l: Owners, permissions, and records; evaluation with indicators; one LOOP-R cycle and the program's final project.

inicio.aulas_sub: In the order a manager redesigns a process: doubt it, choose which one, map it, cut it, distribute the steps, measure, and version. Lesson 8 brings it all together on the canvas.

itens: Area managers, owners of small and midsize businesses, and operations leaders who are about to put AI agents into a process, or already did and can't say whether it got better.
If you don't code and don't want to: here you decide what the process should be. Building the agent or the integration is another course.
If you've heard "just have the AI do it the way we do it" and suspect that's not the way.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Choose the first process by value, feasibility, and risk, and say in writing why not another.
Map the normal path, the detours, the decisions, and today's measures from cases you followed.
Cut, simplify, and move steps before automating, and decide who does each one that's left.
Measure before changing anything, with a denominator, and record each change along with the way to roll it back.

blocos.t: The case that runs through the course
itens: Horizonte Distribuidora, a 40-person fictional study company that distributes cleaning products in the interior of São Paulo.

You play Patrícia Lima, sales manager. The process is the order that arrives through WhatsApp and goes all the way to the invoice. The owner, Carlos, wants to put the sales agent on invoicing too, just as the process stands.
Every lesson has one practice at Horizonte and another on your own process. The map from lesson 3 and the canvas from lesson 8 are for your real work.
